chargingMethod.description: Subcooling (in cooling mode) is the only recommended method of charging above 55º F ambient outdoor temperature (§14.1 STEP 1; method §14.2 'Subcooling Charging in Cooling (Above 55º F Outdoor Temp.)'). [OEM ADVISORY, not a method condition (owner direction 2026-09-27): prose 'For best results the indoor temperature should be kept between 70º F to 80º F'; 'Indoor Temp' graphic ✓ 70–80º F, ✗ above/below. The source does not state that operation outside 70–80º F invalidates the procedure; NIRET does not use it to deny technical entry.]
